We merge design, manufacturing, and automation into one integrated process so customers can develop, validate, and scale breakthrough composite structures faster and with less risk. Prove Fast. Move Fast. Scale With Certainty. You start in our flexible factories, where parts are designed and prototyped quickly. All processing routes are available: RTS automated deposition (steered fiber or conventional), forming and curing (autoclave, press, RTM, HDF), machining, painting, and inspection. Once validated, we deploy a dedicated production line near your facility, with no upfront CapEx, and transition seamlessly to industrial production.
